question: In which of the following soil conservation methods different crops are grown in alternate rows and are sown at different times to protect the soil from rain wash?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intercropping**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Intercropping**

 
 
• Intercropping, on the other hand, involves planting different crops in proximity (**in alternate rows or otherwise**).
 
• This technique helps reduce the risk of soil erosion as well as protects the soil from** rain wash**.
 
• When crops are sown at different times, the soil surface remains covered for a longer period of time, thereby reducing the **direct impact of rainfall**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shelterbelt**

 
 
• Shelter belts are rows of **trees or shrubs planted **in a line to protect an area from wind.
 
• They are also known as **windbreaks**.
 
• Shelter belts can be used to protect** crops, livestock, and homes **from the wind.
 
• They can also help to reduce soil erosion and improve **air quality.**
 
 
 
• **Contour farming **
 
 
• Contour farming or contour plowing involves tilling the soil following the contours of the land, rather than up and **down the slope**.
 
• Plowing along the natural contours of the land, this method reduces runoff, prevents soil erosion, and allows the** soil to retain water better**.
 
• It's a particularly useful method in hilly or sloped areas where** water erosion **can be a significant issue.
 
 
 
• **Terrace farming**
 
 
• Terrace farming is a method of farming that involves building terraces on **sloping land **to **create level surfaces for cultivation**.
 
• Terraces slow down the flow of water and prevent erosion, and they also provide a more stable surface for **crops to grow on**.
 
• Terrace farming is a** traditional agricultural **practice that has been used for centuries in many parts of the world, and it is still widely used today in some areas.
